sources.title: Supergirl S02E01 The Adventures of Supergirl recap - ew.com
sources.verification: Picks up where S01E20 left off: Kara and J'onn find a man asleep in a pod. DEO moves to a new skyscraper facility. Cat gives Kara two days to pick a job. First date with James interrupted by Venture launch sabotage. Superman arrives, team saves the rocket. Tension between Superman and J'onn (Kryptonite stockpile). Lena Luthor was the target, not perpetrator. Lex hired John Corben to kill her. Drone attack on Lena's helicopter. Kara struggles with career and James. Cat's inspirational speech. L-Corp renaming ceremony - Corben attacks again. Alex fights Corben. Supergirl stabilizes building. Lena shoots Corben. Kara tells Cat she wants to be a reporter. Kara tells James they're better as friends. Winn hired at DEO. Superman stays. Cadmus turns Corben into Metallo - cliffhanger.

beats.description: Picks up where S01E20 left off - Kara and J'onn find a man asleep in the pod from the cliffhanger
DEO moves to a new skyscraper facility in National City
Cat gives Kara two days to figure out what job she wants
First date with James - pizza and pot stickers, watching Venture launch on TV
Venture spacecraft launch sabotaged - engine explodes, hull breach
Superman arrives - Kara and Superman team up to save the rocket together
Tension between Superman and J'onn - Kryptonite stockpile conflict
DEO discovers Lena Luthor was supposed to be on the Venture flight - she was the target
Clark and Kara visit Lena as journalists - she cooperates, gives them a drive
Lex Luthor hired John Corben to kill Lena
Corben attacks Lena's helicopter with drones - Supergirl and Superman save her
Kara struggles with career choice and James relationship
Cat's inspirational speech - keep daring, keep diving
L-Corp renaming ceremony - Corben attacks again with bombs at base of building
Superman and Supergirl stabilize the building together
Corben takes Alex hostage with a gun
Alex fights Corben
Lena shoots Corben in the back - two bullets
Kara tells Cat she wants to be a reporter
Kara tells James they're better as friends
Winn officially hired at DEO
Superman decides to stick around National City
Cadmus picks up Corben's body and turns him into Metallo - cliffhanger
